_comment: Manual sidecar SQL migrations applied outside drizzle-kit _journal.json. Listed here so audit-contract-map.mjs treats them as documented_sidecar (WARN) rather than unknown_unjournaled_sql (FAIL).

sidecars.reason: Adds missing gRPC proto alignment indexes and metadata columns. The route_runtime_packets branch is guarded because the table is not present in the live schema.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname IN ('idx_packets_source_feature_multi_hop','atlas_packets_metadata_gin_idx','idx_atlas_packets_payload_path','idx_atlas_packets_feature_id_composite','idx_packets_centroid_cache','idx_task_semantic_packets_metadata_gin','idx_concept_records_feature_ids_gin','idx_concept_records_metadata_gin');"

sidecars.reason: Code-intelligence GIN/trgm and B-tree indexes. Drizzle ORM cannot express GIN trgm ops (USING gin(col gin_trgm_ops)) natively — must live outside the journal.
sidecars.validationCommand: docker exec legal-ai-postgres psql -U legal_admin -d legal_ai_db -c "SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname LIKE '%trgm%' LIMIT 5;"
